data.cultural_impact: The Christian name Annelore has been in usage since the Middle Ages and was popular during the Renaissance period. It was also a common name among German communities in Europe and America. The name is steeped in rich cultural history, representing the grace and elegance of a noblewoman in the era of chivalry and ballads.
data.spiritual_significance: Annelore is a name imbued with spiritual meaning. The Old German name Anna symbolizes divine grace, while Lore represents a deep call to the soul. The name Annelore thus signifies the divine grace that calls to our souls, inviting us to live in alignment with the divine will. It is a reminder of the spiritual connection that exists within each of us, and the profound impact it can have on our lives.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Annelore is a Germanic name derived from the elements 'Adal' meaning noble and 'lora' from Loretta. The name Annelore carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name was used in German-speaking regions during the Middle Ages.

name_in_real_life.story: Grace Annelore, a minister in London, United Kingdom, shares that their name Annelore meaning "Graceful little one" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
